subject: community-medicine
title: Low Osmolarity ORS: Composition 245 and Why It Replaced the Old Formula

steps.title: The universal formula, number by number
steps.tx: **Low osmolarity ORS** contains sodium 75, chloride 65, anhydrous glucose 75, potassium 20 and citrate 10 mmol per litre, totalling 245 mOsm per litre. Recommended jointly by WHO and UNICEF and adopted nationally, it is now the single universal solution for children and adults, cholera included, replacing separate formulas.
steps.say: Memorise five numbers and a total. Sodium seventy five, chloride sixty five, glucose seventy five, potassium twenty, citrate ten: two hundred forty five milliosmoles per litre. One universal solution replaced the older split formulas.

steps.tx: **Low osmolarity ORS** contains sodium 75, chloride 65, anhydrous glucose 75, potassium 20, and citrate 10 mmol per litre. Added together the solution is 245 milliosmoles per litre. WHO and UNICEF recommended it jointly, and national programmes adopted it as the single universal formula for children and adults. Cholera is included, not excluded. Older split formulas, one for ordinary diarrhoea and another for cholera, are no longer required. The same packet therefore serves the whole range of watery diarrhoeal dehydration.
steps.say: Low osmolarity oral rehydration solution has sodium 75, chloride 65, glucose 75, potassium 20, and citrate 10 mmol per litre, totalling 245 milliosmoles. WHO and UNICEF endorsed it, and it is now the one formula for children and adults, cholera included. Separate older recipes are retired.

steps.title: Why lower osmolarity absorbs better
steps.tx: **Reduced osmolarity** (245 against plasma near 290) pulls water inward more reliably and reduces stool output and vomiting compared with the older 311 mOsm formula. Trials showed less unscheduled intravenous therapy without clinically significant hyponatraemia. Sodium at 75 balances childhood gastroenteritis losses while remaining safe, with monitoring, in cholera's saltier stools.
steps.say: Thinner pulls better. At two forty five against plasma's two ninety, water follows inward, stool and vomiting fall, and unscheduled drips decline without dangerous sodium drops. One formula serves gastroenteritis and, monitored, cholera.

steps.title: Citrate instead of bicarbonate
steps.tx: **Citrate** replaced bicarbonate in packets because it survives storage in hot humid climates without degrading or browning with glucose, while converting to bicarbonate in the body to correct acidosis. Packet chemistry is programme chemistry: a formula that dies in a warehouse treats nobody, however elegant its physiology.
steps.say: Citrate survives warehouses. Bicarbonate degraded and browned with glucose in heat and humidity; citrate stores stably and becomes bicarbonate after swallowing. Packet chemistry is programme chemistry in tropical supply chains.

steps.title: Mixing errors that kill
steps.tx: **Mixing accuracy** decides safety: one packet in exactly one litre of clean water. Too little water concentrates salts toward hypernatraemia; extra sugar or salt by spoon improvisation does the same. Solution keeps 24 hours, then is discarded. Tasting should suggest tears, not soup: noticeably salty means remake it, a household rule worth teaching verbatim.
steps.say: One packet, one litre, exactly. Concentrated mixes risk dangerous sodium levels; spoons of extra sugar or salt do the same. Discard after twenty four hours. It should taste like tears, not soup; saltier means remake.

nodes.label: Taste check: like tears, not salty

steps.tx: **Mixing accuracy** is what makes oral rehydration safe. One packet is dissolved in exactly one litre of clean water. Too little water concentrates the salts and pushes the child toward hypernatraemia. Adding sugar or salt by the spoon, outside the packet, does the same harm. Prepared solution may be kept for 24 hours and is then discarded. The taste should suggest tears, not soup. If it tastes noticeably salty, it is remade rather than offered. That household rule is worth repeating in the same words each time.
steps.say: One packet goes into exactly one litre of clean water. Less water, or extra spoonfuls of sugar or salt, concentrates sodium and can cause hypernatraemia. The mix is kept 24 hours, then thrown away. It should taste like tears. If it tastes like salty soup, it is made again.

steps.title: Sugar-salt solution when packets run out
steps.tx: Home **sugar-salt solution** bridges packet absence: a level measure taught locally (commonly six level teaspoons of sugar and half a level teaspoon of salt in one litre of water in standard teaching). Its weakness is measurement error in both directions, which is why programmes prefer packets and reserve home mixing for the first hours of illness.
steps.say: Kitchens bridge packet gaps. Six level teaspoons of sugar, half a level teaspoon of salt, one litre of water in standard teaching. Spoon error cuts both ways, so packets lead and home mixing covers first hours only.

steps.title: What ORS does not do
steps.tx: **ORS limitations** surprise families: stool frequency and duration barely change at first, because ORS replaces losses rather than stopping secretion. Antibiotics stay reserved for dysentery, cholera suspicion and specific indications; antimotility drugs harm children. Setting this expectation keeps mothers administering fluid through day two instead of abandoning a working therapy that looks inactive.
steps.say: Warn families early. Stools continue while fluid saves; ORS replaces losses without switching secretion off. Antibiotics stay narrow, gut-slowing drugs harm children. Expectation set honestly keeps mothers pouring through day two.

steps.title: Cholera stools and sodium vigilance
steps.tx: **Cholera** purges sodium richer than childhood gastroenteritis, so high-volume cholera losses are watched for sodium balance even on the universal formula, with intravenous Ringer lactate for severe purging and antibiotics shortening illness in confirmed outbreaks. Eighty to ninety percent of cholera patients still need no drip when ORS starts early and keeps pace with losses.
steps.say: Cholera tests the universal formula. Saltier purges demand sodium vigilance and rapid matching of losses; severe cases take Ringer lactate and antibiotics. Started early, ORS alone still carries eighty to ninety percent.

steps.title: Reading composition stems
steps.tx: Stems quote numbers as fingerprints: **sodium 75 with total 245** names the current universal formula; sodium 90 with 311 names its predecessor. Citrate 10 distinguishes modern packets from bicarbonate ancestors. A stem describing hypernatraemia after home mixing is testing litre accuracy, not formula choice, and the answer is teaching exact measurement.
steps.say: Numbers fingerprint formulas. Seventy five and two forty five mean current universal; ninety and three eleven mean the ancestor. Harm after home mixing tests litre accuracy, and the corrective answer is exact measurement teaching.

steps.title: One solution for the world: programme logic
steps.tx: **Universal adoption** simplified procurement, training and caregiver teaching to a single packet: one composition to manufacture, stock, teach and trust across ages and causes. Fragmented formulas had multiplied errors at every level. The 245 solution is therefore as much a logistics intervention as a pharmacological one, which is the community medicine point of the whole lesson.
steps.say: Universality is logistics medicine. One packet to manufacture, stock, teach and trust across ages and causes replaced fragmented formulas multiplying errors. The formula's triumph is supply chain design as much as physiology.
